description: The workspace's hosted images, newest first, each with id, filename, content_type, size, width, height and the url to use in an . Look here before uploading a logo the workspace probably already has. At most 100 per call; while has_more is true, next_cursor passed back as cursor returns the next page. url is null when the workspace has no live tracking domain.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, passed back unchanged

name: list_media
